vulnerability_cn: 公开任意外部调用导致 LayerZero delegate 被接管
vulnerability_en: Arbitrary external call enables LayerZero delegate takeover
detail_cn: OFTSand继承的approveAndCall/paidCall只检查首参数和长度，却允许普通调用者让代币合约以自身身份调用任意目标。攻击者用68字节setDelegate数据绕过本地onlyOwner入口，把自己设为应用delegate，再修改已注册ReceiveUln302的required DVN为自己，自行verify并commit伪造消息。历史交易证实首铸5000万SAND，首笔出售1496724.864727844728117234 SAND得到14.64553552927302136 WETH。源表约67万美元与官方后续约69.7万美元未能统一，CSV损失字段留空；两种估计及跨链赎回总额仅作背景，不是本批独立汇总。
detail_en: OFTSand inherited public approveAndCall/paidCall helpers that checked only payload length and the first argument while allowing arbitrary external calls from the token identity. A 68-byte setDelegate payload let an ordinary caller bypass the local owner-only setter, become the application delegate, change the existing ReceiveUln302 required DVN to itself, submit verification, and commit a fabricated message. Archived transactions verify the first mint of 50,000,000 SAND and the first sale of 1,496,724.864727844728117234 SAND for 14.64553552927302136 WETH. The source-sheet estimate of $670,000 and the later official ~$697,000 remain unreconciled, so both CSV loss fields are blank. These estimates and the aggregate cross-chain redemption amount were not independently summed in this batch.
loss_scope: Unresolved discrepancy: source sheet estimates USD 670000 while the later official disclosure estimates approximately USD 697000. No unified incident total was independently established; both CN and EN CSV loss fields must remain blank.
verification_status: Authoritative original sources; Base historical runtime bound; takeover/configure/verify/commit/mint/sale verified from historical transactions and successful receipts. Aggregate incident loss and all Ethereum redemptions remain report-sourced.
